prompt: Which statements are true about the default user of a Redis Cloud database? (Select three.)
explanation: Every database is protected by a default user whose username is default and whose password is stored masked but can be revealed in the console, through Default user > Configure for Essentials databases or the Security section for Pro databases. Once role-based access control is enabled, you can turn the default user off and connect with the username and password of a data access role instead. There is no admin username, and the masked password remains viewable in the console rather than being permanently hidden.

options.text: Its password is masked and can be revealed in the console
Its username is admin and cannot be changed
Once the password is set, it can never be viewed again
With role-based access control enabled, you can turn the default user off and connect with a data access role's user instead
